legacy_note: Saved before device scopes existed: it still runs on every computer, work ones included, and each keeps a copy of the key. Saving any change here makes the scope explicit.
share_all_hint: Every computer you've confirmed as yours; work computers only when added.
share_selected_hint: Only the computers checked below. The others don't see it at all.
share_none_hint: No computer gets the key. It stays on the hub, which still uses it for direct API calls such as triage and translation.
api_hint: The hub calls a direct API itself; the computers here can get the key too.
no_machines: No computers are connected to the hub yet.
push: Keep a copy on each computer
push_hint: Each computer fetches the key as soon as it connects, so launches keep working while the hub is unreachable. Off: a computer fetches it the first time it needs it.
use_own: Also use on computers with their own sign-in
use_own_hint: Off: skipped on a computer where Claude Code or Codex already has its own sign-in, API key or rc-file launcher.
machine_keys_hint: A key here replaces the provider's key on that computer only. Leave it empty to keep what's there.
replace_key: Type a key to replace it
